# temps_project_agent (Resource)

An AI agent of a project: what triggers it, the model and tools it uses, and its budget.

Import with `<project_id>/<slug>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_agent" "triage" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  slug       = "triage"
  name       = "Error triage"
  prompt     = "Investigate new errors and open a pull request with a fix."
  enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the agent.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the agent, unique in the project.

### Optional

- `ai_model` (String) Model name.
- `ai_provider` (String) Model provider, for example `anthropic`.
- `ai_provider_key_id` (Number) ID of the `temps_ai_provider` to bill.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Provider API key of this agent alone. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `branch_prefix` (String) Prefix of the branches the agent pushes.
- `config_repo_branch` (String) Branch of `config_repo_url`.
- `config_repo_url` (String) Repository holding the agent's configuration.
- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Least time between two runs.
- `daily_budget_cents` (Number) Most the agent may spend a day, in cents.
- `deliverable` (String) What a run produces, for example `pull_request`.
- `description` (String) What the agent does.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Let triggers start the agent.
- `max_turns` (Number) Most model turns per run.
- `mcp_servers_config` (String) MCP servers the agent connects to. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `prompt` (String) Instructions the agent runs with.
- `sandbox_enabled` (Boolean) Run the agent in a sandbox.
- `skills_config` (String) Skills the agent loads. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Longest a run may take.
- `tools_config` (String) Tools the agent may use. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `trigger_config` (String) What starts a run (schedule, webhook, events). A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<slug>`.
- `source` (String) Where the agent's definition comes from.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL that starts a run when the agent has a webhook trigger.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<slug>
terraform import temps_project_agent.triage 8/triage
```
